notes.title: We have a demo on the way!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,
[/p][p]We’re super excited to announce that our very first demo will be out on Steam on the 29th of September! That’s less than 2 weeks until you lovely folks can try out On-Together 🍅
[/p][p]Here are some things to look forward to in the demo:
[/p][p][b]Virtual work hangs with your friends[/b][/p][p]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Study, work, or do your life admin together![/p][p][/p][p][b]Pet companions[/b][/p][p]🐇 The cutest furry friends will chill on your desk while you’re focusing or on your head when you walk, swim or fly! They’ll even jump-rope with you![/p][p][/p][p][b]Mini Games[/b][/p][p]🎣 Fishing[/p][p]🏀 Basketball[/p][p]🎸 Music Jam 
[/p][p][b]Focus activities [/b][/p][p]🧘 Read, write, meditate and more![/p][p][/p][p][b]Cute productivity tools [/b][/p][p]🍅 Pomodoro timer[/p][p]📚 Journal[/p][p]📑 Task Tracking[/p][p][/p][p][b]Unlockables![/b][/p][p]🍭 Treats in the canteen[/p][p]🐟 Bait and rods for fishing[/p][p]🖌️ Customisable items[/p][p][/p][p]This and more is waiting for you in the demo, so be sure to wishlist and stay notified on all things On-Together! 
[/p][p]See you on the 29th!! 👋[/p][p]GigaPuff 💖[/p]

notes.title: We’re in the Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam! 🍅
notes.content:
[p]Hello Friends!
[/p][p]We’re super excited today to say we are a part of the fabulous Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam 🥰 This is such a lovely event and we are so pleased to involved again after announcing our game with Wholesome!
[/p][p]Be sure to go check out all the wholesome titles and be sure to keep your eyes peeled for more updates from us 👀
[/p][p]For now here’s a little teaser:

[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to On-Together 🍅
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]
[/p][p]We’re GigaPuff and On-Together is our debut game! A social chatroom where you can work, play games and hang out with your friends. ☺️ We wanted to design a digital lounge to help you stay focused at work while technically still hanging out with your mates![/p][p]
You can watch our trailer below, which got revealed during the Women Led Games showcase after a teaser trailer in Wholesome Direct - what a night!:
[/p][previewyoutube="RY54ZmRZmhc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here’s what you can look forward to:[/p][p]🍅Hang out in full screen, or in a smaller window, or try out sticker mode![/p][p]🍅A chat feature to catch up with your buddies[/p][p]🍅Productivity tools like focus timers, to-do lists, progress trackers and calendars[/p][p]🍅If you stay focused long enough, a super cute pet friend will join you![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you’re working from home or revising for exams we think this is the perfect way to do it! Our publishers Future Friends Games can attest to as they’ve been holding their meetings in On-Together recently and it seems to be going well 👀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIh9IqPEmCbxTtxIPcKGC3RqCKnLLTi740uycY7W8R5j4NbzZHxQBXyuBz1oHYKar3XoKICcHnQzl9mj2uEK5_tODkHeIuW2G7iTYo8BchtZRrA_gQxVFtwJ6N9UfiPl4IOpH_KQ?key=xkDHyIFrziCQCxkCGxZ5zA"][/img][/p][p]Here are the two Laura’s working in On-Together, in sticker mode 🥰[/p][p][/p][p]So now that you have got to know our game a little, we hope that you will hit that [b]wishlist button[/b] to stay updated on what’s to come! You can also follow us on our socials:[/p][list][*][p][u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/on-together.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://x.com/OnTogetherGame"]Twitter/ X[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ontogethergame"]Tiktok[/url][/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][url="https://www.instagram.com/on.together.game"]Instagram[/url][/u][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you soon![/p][p][/p][p]Bye for now,[/p][p]GigaPuff 💖[/p][p]
[/p]
